events.event: Bareskrim Polri questioned Projo chair Budi Arie for about 10 hours as a witness in the alleged makar (subversion) case involving ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit; he said he knows only Listyo Sigit among the six suspects and denied his political-analysis video is linked to the case; a former Jokowi personal assistant was also summoned.
events.key_numbers: ~10 hours of questioning (8-10 hrs per outlets) · 6 suspects · 27 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: The makar case is widening from police officers to political figures; being a witness is not being a suspect.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional front page (5 articles on Budi Arie); Detik most-commented list on the case

events.event: Polri dismissed Kombes Iman Imanuddin, former Dirreskrimum, from the force after an ethics process found he ordered an investigation stopped (a case in North Jakarta); he said he will appeal.
events.why_it_matters: Shows how far Polri's clean-up under the new Kapolri goes, down to who may stop a case.

events.event: A military court sentenced Letjen TNI Widi Prasetijono, a former aide to Jokowi, to 5 years in prison and dismissal from the TNI in the Caruy land corruption case; he declared an appeal immediately.
events.key_numbers: 5 years prison · dismissal from military service · 26 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: A three-star general jailed for corruption is rare; verdict is not final because of the appeal.

events.event: At Bank Indonesia's annual meeting President Prabowo said Indonesia's governance is not good enough and warned state institutions and ministries to clean themselves or be cleaned, while praising the new Kapolri.
events.why_it_matters: The president publicly admitting weak governance in front of bankers and investors, with rupiah at record lows.

events.event: KPK said the Klaten MURI-record chicken soup procurement (9,222 portions) was marked up by Rp35,000 per bowl.
events.why_it_matters: A simple, relatable example of how a local event budget gets inflated; still an allegation by KPK.

events.event: Kejagung is tracking nickel businessman Arif Kurniawan, a corruption and money-laundering suspect who reportedly left for China after skipping three summonses.
events.why_it_matters: A major nickel figure being a fugitive links the mining sector to the makar narrative; CNBC headline mentions a possible makar role, unverified.

events.event: DPR Komisi III chair Habiburokhman proposed electing the new vice president by deliberation (musyawarah), with voting only if deadlocked.
events.key_numbers: 2 candidates: Sugiono, Andi Amran Sulaiman · health results to be announced 1 Dec
events.why_it_matters: How the MPR picks the VP decides whether the two nominees pass without a contest.

events.event: The MPR's Mukernas II decided that LDII is barred from MUI leadership.
events.key_numbers: Decision at MUI Mukernas II, 26 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Touches a large religious organisation; reaction from LDII is still to come.

events.event: Komisi X DPR is trying to get a minimum teacher salary equal to the UMP into the RUU Sisdiknas.
events.why_it_matters: Would raise pay for many teachers if it survives the bill; still only an effort.

events.event: At Hari Guru Nasional President Prabowo launched Studio Guru and said ASN teacher allowances reached Rp70.64 trillion through November.
events.key_numbers: Rp70.64 trillion teacher allowance (ASN) through Nov · 4 smart screens per school target end-2026
events.why_it_matters: Concrete spending number for teachers and schools.

events.event: Demokrat issued a legal warning (somasi) to three YouTube accounts that alleged SBY met Jokowi to discuss 2029.
events.why_it_matters: Political rumour mill ahead of 2029; the claim is denied by Demokrat.

events.event: Gerindra Kupang said it awaits the DPP's decision on the status of Kupang Regent Yosef Lede, a rape suspect.
events.why_it_matters: Whether the party sanctions a regent who is a suspect.

gaps: Article bodies could not be opened (WebFetch permission not granted), so details rest on headlines and search snippets; key numbers beyond headlines unverified.
Ulta Levenia dismissed from Bakom RI (CNN, 27 Nov): reason unknown.
Listyo second KKEP summons 30 Nov and MPR health-result announcement 1 Dec already known (E1149, E1178), not re-reported.
Prabowo 'old economy / no stocks' remark (CNN 27 Nov) left to the business sweep.
